_doc: Seven investigator classes (design doc: Systems v2). stats are starting values for Reason, Charm, Grit, Intuition. Skills unlock at the given level; damage types are physical, signal, spirit, reason, arcane. Skills: type damage|status|heal|shield|revive, target foe|ally|self|all_foes|all_allies, level gates, focus_cost/evidence_cost/dread_cost, and the extras hits, apply (+apply_chance), pierce, execute, drain, scale:dread, self_damage, push, cleanse, focus_gain, evidence_gain, fraction (revive). fx names the animation.

skeptic.name: Skeptic
skeptic.blurb: A physicist. Catches lies, exposes hoaxes and shields the team from fear.

skills.name: Reason
skills.text: A plain question with no good answer.

skills.name: Disbelieve
skills.text: Nothing here can hurt you if it is not real.

skills.name: Cross-Examine
skills.text: Two questions, back to back. The story does not match.

skills.name: Steady
skills.text: Breathe. Count the exits. Say what you actually saw.

skills.name: Occam's Razor
skills.text: The simplest explanation, said out loud.

journalist.name: Field Journalist
journalist.blurb: Gets people talking. Documents threats until they weaken.

skills.name: Question
skills.text: Who, what, where, and why are you lying?

skills.name: Exposure
skills.text: Everything it is, in the open.

skills.name: Flash
skills.text: The bulb goes off in every face at once.

skills.name: Headline
skills.text: Tomorrow's front page, read aloud.

skills.name: Scoop
skills.text: The one detail nobody else has. The team sits up.

signals.name: Signals Tech
signals.blurb: Radios, tape and static. Hits every enemy at once and jams their turns.

skills.name: Feedback
skills.text: The recorder squeals and everything flinches.

skills.name: Jam
skills.text: White noise on its frequency.

skills.name: Sweep
skills.text: A directional antenna finds it and keeps it.

skills.name: Broadcast
skills.text: Everything recorded so far, played back at volume.

skills.name: Overload
skills.text: Every battery in the kit into one pulse. It hurts to be near.

folklorist.name: Folklorist
folklorist.blurb: Knows the old stories. Wards the team and finds the weak point in a legend.

skills.name: Old Story
skills.text: There is a name for you, and it is old.

skills.name: Salt Line
skills.text: A line it will not cross.

skills.name: Hymn
skills.text: Everybody knows the second verse.

skills.name: Ward
skills.text: Iron, rowan and a word for each of you.

skills.name: Litany
skills.text: Every story in which the thing in the dark loses.

medium.name: Medium
medium.blurb: Hears what others miss. Calms the team and reads the anomaly.

skills.name: Unsettle
skills.text: Whatever it is, it did not expect to be seen.

skills.name: Calm
skills.text: A hand on the shoulder. The room comes back.

skills.name: Séance
skills.text: Hands joined, breath slowed, the table still.

skills.name: Channel
skills.text: Hold still. Someone wants a word with you.

skills.name: Crossing Over
skills.text: Come back. It is not your time, and we need you.

crypto.name: Cryptozoologist
crypto.blurb: Tracker and field biologist. Handles animals and reads the ground.

skills.name: Track
skills.text: Read the ground, then close the distance.

skills.name: Net
skills.text: Weighted nylon, thrown low.

skills.name: Bait
skills.text: Stand in the open and let it come.

skills.name: Field Kit
skills.text: Gauze, a flask, and a plaster cast of whatever that was.

skills.name: Takedown
skills.text: Three hits, each one timed.

occultist.name: Occultist
occultist.blurb: The true spellcaster. Salt, Silver, Iron and Sigil, at the cost of Dread.

skills.name: Silver Word
skills.text: A syllable that was never meant for air.

skills.name: Iron Bind
skills.text: Nails in a circle. Stay.

skills.name: Hex
skills.text: A knot tied in its name.

skills.name: Sigil Storm
skills.text: Chalk and salt and something borrowed.

skills.name: Black Candle
skills.text: The worse it gets, the brighter it burns.
